name: Seeking Spiritual Aid
statusNote: Unchanged in Forever as far as is known: the text, objectives and rewards below are Classic’s.
footerSourceNote: Text, givers, objectives and rewards come from the cMaNGOS Classic database (a reconstruction of the 1.12 world), with what Forever changed on top: the game server’s own answers where we have them, else Wowhead’s Forever database. Places are Classic’s, shown on the Forever maps. Quest text © Blizzard Entertainment.

narrative.details:
Take the corrupt water to the Barrens, adventurer. South of Ratchet, hidden along the shore, is an old friend of mine, a shaman named Islen Waterseer. She is a powerful shaman who will help us. Her relationship with the spirits of water has always been strong. Our task being a noble one should be enough to persuade her and the spirits of water to aid us in this task.

You should find her at a small camp right along the water's edge. And, adventurer, ignore the pirates... they are but a nuisance and no threat to you.
narrative.objectives: Take the Corrupt Moon Well Water to Islen Waterseer in the Barrens.
narrative.offerRewardText:
Ah, you need the water from this Moon Well cleansed. Stopping this force of malice in Felwood seems noble enough, but it is not for me to decide if the water will be purified. I will ask the spirits of water--it will be up to them to decide if the cause is just.

Give me a moment and I will tell them of your plea. I hope they are as sympathetic as I am to your cause.
narrative.requestItemsText: I sense you are not just a simple traveler looking for the path to Ratchet. Come, sit and rest at our camp. Speak to me when you're ready.

chain.subtitle: 6 quests from level 51 to 58, 28,900 XP in all.

quests.name: Forces of Jaedenar
quests.objectiveText: Enter Jaedenar and slay 4 Jaedenar Hounds, 4 Jaedenar Guardsmen, 6 Jaedenar Adepts, and 6 Jaedenar Cultists before returning to Greta Mosshoof in Felwood.

quests.name: Collection of the Corrupt Water
quests.objectiveText: Take the Empty Canteen to the Moon Well in the center of Jaedenar and fill it before returning to Greta Mosshoof in Felwood.

quests.name: Seeking Spiritual Aid
quests.objectiveText: Take the Corrupt Moon Well Water to Islen Waterseer in the Barrens.

quests.name: Cleansed Water Returns to Felwood
quests.objectiveText: Take the Purified Moon Well Water to Greta Mosshoof in Felwood.

quests.name: Dousing the Flames of Protection
quests.objectiveText: Using the Purified Moon Well Water, douse the flames of the four braziers of protection within Shadow Hold in Felwood, then return to Greta Mosshoof in the Emerald Sanctuary.

quests.name: A Final Blow
quests.objectiveText: Kill Moora and Salia, and bring Shadow Lord Fel'dan's Head to Greta Mosshoof in Felwood.
